name: Shino Hajime
source:
If only judged by his appearance, Hajime can easily be mistaken as a girl, but he is pretty strong. He is composed and selfless, but sometimes he's also a little pessimistic. Hajime delivers low-profile yet delicate performances with a singing voice like a demure maid.

Hajime is a member of Ra*bits at Rhythm Link.

[From in-game profile]
